title: AROMA-CAFE
description:
Aroma Cafe — E-Commerce & Cafe Management Platform
📖 Overview

Aroma Cafe is a full-featured digital platform designed to connect a cafe's customer ordering experience with its day-to-day operations through a single, unified system.

The platform provides customers with a modern online storefront for browsing the menu, placing orders, tracking orders in real time, and reserving tables. At the same time, cafe staff can manage orders, reservations, menu items, and daily operations through a dedicated real-time admin dashboard.

The result is a complete ecosystem that brings the cafe's digital storefront, ordering workflow, and operational management into one platform.

🎯 Problem & Solution

Local cafes and restaurants often rely on a combination of third-party food delivery platforms, manual order handling, messaging apps, and disconnected management tools.

This creates several challenges:

High platform commissions reduce profit margins.
Fragmented workflows make it difficult to manage online orders, reservations, and walk-in operations together.
Delayed communication can result in missed or incorrectly handled orders.
Limited ownership of customer data makes it harder for businesses to build direct relationships with their customers.
Aroma Cafe's Approach

Aroma Cafe addresses these problems by providing a proprietary ordering and management platform built specifically around the cafe's workflow.

Customers can place orders and reserve tables through the website, while staff receive real-time updates and audio notifications whenever new orders arrive.

This creates a direct connection between the customer and the cafe while giving the business greater control over its operations, digital presence, and customer experience.

🛠️ Tech Stack
Frontend
Next.js
React
App Router
Server Actions
Tailwind CSS
shadcn/ui
Backend & Data
Firebase Firestore for real-time database synchronization
Firebase Authentication for secure user authentication
Firebase Admin SDK for administrative operations and role-based access
State & Validation
Zustand for global state management
React Hook Form for form handling
Zod for schema-based validation
Media
Cloudinary for image storage, optimization, transformation, and delivery
🏗️ Architecture & Product Approach

The platform is organized into two primary experiences that operate on top of a shared real-time backend.

1. Customer Storefront

The customer-facing application is designed around simplicity, speed, and conversion.

Customers can:

Browse an interactive digital menu
Explore categorized food and beverages
Add items to a persistent cart
Checkout as a guest or authenticated user
Track orders in real time
Reorder previously purchased items
Check table availability
Reserve tables online

The interface also uses responsive layouts, micro-interactions, and lightweight animations to create a modern and premium browsing experience.

2. Admin Dashboard

The admin application is designed around operational efficiency.

Using Firestore's real-time listeners, the dashboard functions as a lightweight Point of Sale and Kitchen Display System.

Staff can:

Monitor incoming orders in real time
Update order statuses
Receive audio alerts for new orders
Manage menu items and categories
Upload and manage menu images
Review and manage reservations
Control operational data from a centralized dashboard

Administrative routes are protected using role-based access control, ensuring that sensitive management functionality is accessible only to authorized users.

🚀 Key Features
👤 Customer Experience

Interactive Digital Menu
Customers can explore categorized menu items with rich imagery and detailed information.

Smart Cart
Cart state is persisted to provide a consistent shopping experience across sessions.

Flexible Checkout
Customers can complete orders as guests or authenticated users.

Real-Time Order Tracking
Order progress updates live as it moves through different stages such as:

Pending → Preparing → Ready

No manual page refresh is required.

Table Reservations
Customers can view availability and reserve tables through an intuitive booking interface.

Reordering
Previously purchased items can be reordered quickly for a faster repeat-purchase experience.

🧑‍💼 Admin Experience

Live Kitchen Dashboard
Incoming orders appear in real time, giving staff an immediate view of the active order queue.

Audio Order Alerts
New orders trigger audio notifications so staff can respond quickly during busy periods.

Menu Management
Administrators can create, update, and remove menu items and manage their associated images.

Reservation Management
Staff can review, approve, reject, and manage table reservations from a centralized interface.

Role-Based Access Control
Administrative functionality is protected through authenticated roles and server-side authorization.

⚡ Performance & Engineering

Performance was considered throughout the application rather than treated as a final-stage optimization.

Server-Side Rendering & Static Generation

Next.js Server Components and hybrid rendering are used to minimize unnecessary client-side JavaScript while improving initial page performance and SEO.

Image Optimization

Cloudinary handles image transformation and delivery, allowing images to be resized and served in modern formats based on the application's requirements.

Optimistic UI

Frequently used interactions such as cart updates and status changes use optimistic UI patterns to make the interface feel immediate while the underlying operation completes.

Efficient Real-Time Updates

Firestore snapshot listeners are scoped carefully to reduce unnecessary updates and prevent excessive React re-renders when application state changes.

🔐 Security & Access Control

Aroma Cafe separates customer functionality from administrative functionality using authentication and authorization layers.

Firebase Authentication handles user identity, while administrative privileges are controlled through custom claims and server-side authorization.

This ensures that sensitive operations such as menu management, order administration, and reservation management cannot be accessed simply by navigating to protected routes.

📈 What Aroma Cafe Demonstrates

Aroma Cafe is more than a restaurant website. It demonstrates the ability to design and build a production-oriented full-stack application that combines:

Customer-facing e-commerce
Real-time database synchronization
Authentication and authorization
Administrative workflows
Order management
Reservation management
Media management
State management
Performance optimization
Responsive UI design

The project brings these pieces together into a single product designed around a real-world business workflow.

caseStudy.problem: Local cafes often depend on multiple disconnected systems for online ordering, table reservations, and daily order management. This leads to fragmented workflows, delayed order communication, third-party platform commissions, and limited control over the customer experience. Aroma Cafe was built as a unified platform connecting the customer storefront with a real-time cafe management dashboard.
caseStudy.architecture: Built with Next.js (App Router) and React using Server Components, Server Actions, and hybrid rendering. Firebase Firestore provides the real-time data layer, while Firebase Authentication and custom claims handle authentication and role-based access control. Zustand manages client-side state such as carts and live order queues. React Hook Form + Zod provide validated form workflows, and Cloudinary handles optimized media storage and delivery. The customer storefront and admin dashboard operate on a shared real-time backend.
challenges: Designing a real-time order workflow between customers and cafe staff
Synchronizing order status changes without page refreshes
Implementing secure admin-only routes with role-based access control
Managing persistent cart state for guest and authenticated users
Building a responsive UI across desktop, tablet, and mobile
Handling image uploads and optimized media delivery through Cloudinary
Preventing unnecessary re-renders while using real-time Firestore listeners
Designing the admin dashboard for fast operation during high-order periods

title: BLOOD-LINE
description:
Blood-Line is a full-stack web application designed to streamline blood donation and request workflows by connecting donors and recipients in real time.

Problem:
In critical situations, accessing blood quickly is hindered by fragmented communication, unverified donor information, and the absence of a real-time coordination system—leading to dangerous delays.

Solution:
Blood-Line is a real-time blood donation platform that introduces a structured, dual-dashboard system connecting donors and recipients. It enables instant request creation, live tracking, and efficient donor response, ensuring faster and more reliable access to blood during emergencies.

The platform implements a dual-dashboard system:

Receiver Dashboard enables users to create and manage urgent blood requests with live status tracking.
Donor Dashboard allows registered donors to discover nearby requests and respond efficiently.

Core system features include:

Secure user authentication and profile management
Real-time blood request creation and updates using Firestore
Structured data modeling for donors, receivers, and request lifecycle
Payment gateway integration (Razorpay test mode) to simulate transaction flows
Responsive UI optimized for accessibility and clarity

The project emphasizes real-world usability, focusing on reducing friction in emergency scenarios while maintaining scalable architecture and clean UI design.

caseStudy.problem: In critical situations, accessing blood quickly is hindered by fragmented communication, unverified donor information, and the absence of a real-time coordination system—leading to dangerous delays.
caseStudy.architecture: Built on React with Tailwind CSS and backed by Firebase Firestore real-time listeners. Separates concerns into a Receiver Dashboard (urgent blood requests & status tracker) and a Donor Dashboard (geolocation-based request discovery & quick dispatch).
challenges: Preventing race conditions when multiple donors accept the same urgent request concurrently via Firestore transactions
Optimizing mobile viewport responsiveness for high-stress emergency workflows with zero confusing clutter
Simulating transactional integrity with Razorpay test mode payment hooks
